executive_summary: Scottie Scheffler presents exceptional value at +431 odds with an 18.8% model win probability and the #1 strokes gained approach ranking (+1.18) that perfectly matches Riviera's precision demands. The model identifies significant value across the board, with Rory McIlroy (+1628) offering 5.8% win probability despite poor course history, while longshots like Ben Griffin (+5320) provide compelling top-10 value at 20.3% with elite +1.44 total strokes gained. Course fit data reveals concerning negative adjustments for several favorites, creating opportunities in undervalued ball-strikers.

insights.title: Scheffler Massive Value Despite Favoritism
insights.insight: Model shows 18.8% win probability against +431 odds for an enormous +18.6% edge. Leads field in approach play (+1.18 SG) which is critical at Riviera's elevated greens.

insights.title: McIlroy Course History Red Flag
insights.insight: Despite 5.8% model win probability, his recent Riviera results show decline: T29 (2023), T24 (2024), T17 (2025) with poor kikuyu grass experience.

insights.title: Si Woo Kim Ball-Striking Edge
insights.insight: Ranks #2 in field for approach play (+0.95 SG) at +3897 odds with 2.5% model win probability. Recent MC and T44 finishes create value opportunity.

insights.title: Matsuyama Defending Champion Discount
insights.insight: 2024 winner now +3342 odds with 2.9% model win probability despite concerning -0.018 course fit. T13 finish in 2025 shows current form questions.

insights.title: Griffin Longshot With Elite Profile
insights.insight: +5320 odds hide impressive +1.44 total strokes gained with 20.3% top-10 probability. Model sees legitimate contender at massive price.

insights.title: Negative Course Fit Favorites
insights.insight: Russell Henley (-0.163), Collin Morikawa (-0.166), and Tommy Fleetwood (-0.115) all show poor Riviera adjustments despite top-10 odds.

insights.title: MacIntyre Putting Edge Longshot
insights.insight: Ranks #4 in putting (+0.54 SG) at +5513 odds with 19.8% top-10 probability. Strong total game (+1.35 SG) creates value.

insights.title: Adam Scott Course History King
insights.insight: Leads field with +0.227 positive course adjustment at +7573 odds. Historical Riviera excellence could overcome recent form concerns.

insights.title: Ball-Striking Premium Play
insights.insight: Collin Morikawa ranks #3 in approach (+0.90 SG) with positive +0.086 course history despite -0.166 current fit adjustment at +4061 odds.
